candidates.name: Howard Hang
candidates.reason: Live employer profile at https://www.scripps.edu/faculty/hang/ verifies Howard C. Hang as Professor and Department Chair of Immunology & Microbiology (with a joint appointment in Chemistry) at Scripps Research in La Jolla, California. It documents his PhD in Chemistry from UC Berkeley (2003) and BS from UC Santa Cruz (1998), satisfying tests 1 and 2. An employer-published profile interview in Scripps Research Magazine (Fall 2021, 'It takes guts', https://magazine.scripps.edu/profiles/2021/fall/it-takes-guts/) explicitly confirms he was born in Vietnam and immigrated to the US with his family at age four, providing affirmative biographical evidence beyond the shared surname (test 3). Physically located in the United States (test 5). Ran find-roster-matches with the candidate name and submitted URLs; no roster or retired-id matches found (test 4).

candidates.name: Tam Tran
candidates.reason: The submitted profileUrl https://www.stjude.org/research/departments/pathology/research-division/atg-core.html is a departmental/core-facility team-wide page, not an individual profile page; team-wide pages that do not single out the person are expressly unacceptable as profileUrl under test 1. An independent lab team page at https://www.stjude.org/research/labs/xu-jian-lab/xu-jian-lab-team.html also lists Tam Tran under personnel, but is likewise a shared team roster. St. Jude publishes no individual staff profile page for Tam Tran, and no personal website stating the current role was found. Furthermore, neither employer page nor independent biographical sources supply an affirmative Vietnamese biographical or lineage signal beyond the romanized name; 'Tran' can romanize Chinese Chen and 'Tam' is also a common Cantonese name, failing test 3. Doctoral institution, graduation year, and independent research career ladder status also remain unverified from primary sources.
